findings.title: Unauthenticated Session Injection
findings.evidence: sessions_scope has no auth middleware: only Cors::permissive() + ExtractRealm; upsert_session accepts arbitrary session records

findings.title: Unauthenticated Session JWT Read
findings.evidence: get_session_by_id returns full session_data including cookie_string (raw JWT) without any authentication

findings.title: Permissive CORS on All Scopes Including Admin
findings.evidence: Cors::permissive() applied on 12+ scopes including /admins/realms and /admins; TODO comment at line 324 acknowledges this

findings.title: no_jwt_validation Feature Disables All JWT Security
findings.evidence: #[cfg(feature = no_jwt_validation)] uses insecure_decode skipping all signature/expiry/issuer checks; no compile_error! guard for non-test builds

findings.title: Deterministic Argon2 Salt Derived from Username
findings.evidence: Salt = SaltString::b64_encode(SHA256(username)) — fully predictable for known usernames, enabling targeted precomputation

findings.title: No Brute-Force Protection on /login Endpoint
findings.evidence: No rate-limit middleware, no per-account lockout, no attempt counter anywhere in username_password.rs or auth_verifier.rs

findings.title: SSRF via Kubernetes JWKS URL Fetch
findings.evidence: jwks_url validated for https:// prefix only; no private-IP block; fetch_jwks() makes outbound HTTPS to attacker-controlled URL

findings.title: No Structured Audit Log for Authentication Events
findings.evidence: Only free-form debug!/info! calls; no structured audit event type; no audit sink; no tamper protection

findings.title: Plaintext Dev Credentials in TOML Config
findings.evidence: admin_password and totp_password are plain String fields in DevSeedParams, stored in cleartext in auth_verifier.dev.toml

findings.title: Secure Cookie Always Set Including in Plain-HTTP Dev Mode
findings.evidence: cookie.set_secure(true) hardcoded; server can bind plain HTTP when tls_params is None; browser rejects Secure cookies over HTTP

findings.title: EnsureAuth Default-Username Bypass (INFO)
findings.evidence: When auth_is_configured=false and default_username set, all requests injected with that identity; no startup warning emitted
